label: G01_CATALOG_COMPARISON
hosted_access: read-only SELECT on pg_catalog and the migration ledgers; no business rows, no mutation

baseline.construction: frozen AC bootstrap commands from 1bdca37 (CP4.5a catalog bootstrap + v2.6.18..v2.6.20 files), stopped after v2.6.20

platform_ledger.reason: the fixture ledger keeps empty statements and the test chain uses repository version stamps; content and order were matched separately in ledger_content_order.json

sequence.finding: baseline has app_access_audit_id_seq1 and production_pattern_audit_id_seq1 (identity sequences created by the fixture restore) and four sequences not OWNED BY their columns; hosted sequences are owned by their columns
sequence.proof: hash of hosted app_access_audit_id_seq equals baseline app_access_audit_id_seq1; baseline standalone sequences hash feed75... (no owner column)

relation.finding: every hosted relation hash matches; the two extra baseline rows are the *_seq1 sequences

relation_owner_acl.finding: counts differ by the two extra sequences; ACL rows not drilled further
relation_owner_acl.label: NOT_TESTED_PER_OBJECT

schema.finding: erp schema ACL: hosted {postgres=UC, authenticated=U, service_role=U}; baseline has postgres only (the harness grants usage per test group); public matches

view.finding: definitions differ in text; not redefined by v2.6.18..v2.6.20; cause very likely the same pretty-print round trip as the constraints
view.label: PLAUSIBLE, per-view text of the baseline not yet printed

constraint.finding: CHECK constraints written as IN (...) on varchar columns. The CP4.5a fixture stores the pretty-printed form; re-parsing it pushes the text cast into each array element, so pg_get_constraintdef differs while the meaning is the same
constraint.proof: local PG reproduction: fixture text -> 662ff6031e0e (baseline hash of material_transfers_status_check); original IN form -> 12080adf85a2 (hosted hash)
constraint.label: PROVEN_LOCAL_SQL

release_impact.finding: migrations AO..AV (20260922135612 to 20260923110000) embed full-catalog guards that pin constraint, view, sequence and schema ACL text captured on the test chain; on hosted these guards would very likely refuse (fail closed, no damage, release blocked)
release_impact.label: STATIC; refusal itself RERUN_REQUIRED on a hosted-faithful baseline
release_impact.functions_ok: all 537 function bodies, owners and ACLs match, so function pins in earlier successors hold

hosted_detail_reads: constraint hashes per table and per constraint for 17 tables
